answer: To resist sybils, the economy requires every agent to periodically emit a unique opal-style cryptographic commitment by grinding a quartz-hard puzzle bound to its private key and a public seed. Voting or mining weight then ripples only along edges proven by mutual attestation, decaying with distance. An attacker must pay full puzzle cost and forge consistent multi-hop histories for each fake identity, turning scale into a super-linear expense that honest agents avoid after their single setup.
